problem_text:
A logistics firm must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance checks at four distinct regional facilities.

The travel times between facilities, recorded in minutes, are as follows:
* Facility Alpha to Facility Beta: 184.2 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Facility Gamma: 71.6 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Facility Delta: 94.6 minutes
* Facility Beta to Facility Gamma: 126.8 minutes
* Facility Beta to Facility Delta: 94.5 minutes
* Facility Gamma to Facility Delta: 64.0 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, wherein the technician must visit each facility precisely once before concluding the tour back at the initial facility.
